episodes.description: Nobody talks about this, but I will — bad PMS symptoms can wreck your motherhood, your marriage, and your mental health for days every single month. The mood swings. The rage. The crying over nothing. The physical pain that makes you want to curl up on the couch while four kids need you. It's real, it's hard, and you deserve to talk about it. In this episode, I address the physical and emotional toll of hormonal fluctuations honestly. We talk about: * What's actually happening in your body during PMS (and why it's so intense) * The difference between normal PMS and something that needs medical

episodes.title: Lice, Mice and Other Awful Seasons
episodes.short: Lice, Mice and Other Awful Seasons
episodes.description: Have you ever had a terrible infestation? It's an awful experience. I talk about the steps we have to take when this happens so we don't lose hope that things will be normal again.

episodes.title: Taking on the Emotions of Others | How Catholic Moms can manage the emotional weight experienced by friends and family.
episodes.short: Taking on the Emotions of Others | How Catholic Moms can manage the emotional weight experienced by friends and family.
episodes.description: It is a great gift of women to sense other's emotions and to hold their hearts. But when we do this too deeply and carry it away with us, it drains us and isn't helpful at all. Let's talk about it. Check out our free lenten resources for Catholic Moms!

episodes.title: When Life is Lent
episodes.short: When Life is Lent
episodes.description: Is your life super hard and making it harder for Lent sounds impossible? Don't worry! I've got a simple way you can grow closer to the Lord this Lenten season without adding more pain.

episodes.title: A Lent Game Plan
episodes.short: A Lent Game Plan
episodes.description: It's Ash Wednesday! What are you doing for Lent? Here are some really helpful ways to think about how we can grow closer to Christ in this time!

episodes.title: Being in Two Places at Once
episodes.short: Being in Two Places at Once
episodes.description: One of the reasons we feel crazy as modern moms is because we are often asked to be in two places at once - present with our kids but also planning for the future. Are you already thinking about summer? Let's talk about how we can manage this modern challenge well! Join us for our Lenten Declutter Challenge!

episodes.title: When You're Exhausted
episodes.short: When You're Exhausted
episodes.description: Are you in a season of exhaustion? I didn't get much sleep the other night and it brought back all those post-baby sleepless months. Let's talk about how to coach yourself through that!

episodes.title: Getting Rid of Our Golden Calves
episodes.short: Getting Rid of Our Golden Calves
episodes.description: Things we love have a sneaky way of becoming mini golden calves in our lives. Today I talk about how we can identify things we're too attached to and learn to loosen our attachment to them. Join us for the Lenten Declutter Challenge .

episodes.title: What I've Been Doing Lately
episodes.short: What I've Been Doing Lately
episodes.description: Weddings, pregnancy, and the importance of letting God be in charge of your life. If you want to improve your sex life, check out Ellen's Catholix Sex Course here .

episodes.title: Be Open to God's Surprises!
episodes.short: Be Open to God's Surprises!
episodes.description: God gave us a big surprise this month - we got a dog quite unexpectedly. It's been such a lovely gift to our family and one that was surprisingly difficult for me to receive. I share all about it in today's episode! Check out our Lenten resources at www.catholicmomcalm.com

episodes.title: How to Find True Community
episodes.short: How to Find True Community
episodes.description: We're all so lonely! And the reason is... it's HARD to create community. I want to acknowledge that it's hard but I think we must fight for it anyway. Watch my FREE painful marriage course at www.catholicmarriagehope.com

episodes.title: You Didn't Screw it Up
episodes.short: You Didn't Screw it Up
episodes.description: If you're living through something abnormal and feeling weird... you're not doing it wrong. You're having a NORMAL reaction to an ABNORMAL situation. This applies to transitioning from Christmas to regular life, postpartum, post surgery, moving, etc.

episodes.title: Doing a Month End Review
episodes.short: Doing a Month End Review
episodes.description: Spending ten minutes a month doing a month end review is so powerful! It will significantly help you make improvements in your life. It's easy to do and fun! I highly recommend doing it with friends if you can. Come join us in Catholic Mom Calm for 2025.

episodes.title: Jubilee Year of hope
episodes.short: Jubilee Year of hope
episodes.description: The church has declared this a jubilee year of hope! What a wonderful way to step into the new year. Come Join Catholic Mom Calm for the year!

episodes.title: Pray + Plan = Peace
episodes.short: Pray + Plan = Peace
episodes.description: Merry Christmas (if you're listening to this on the day it comes out) and let's talk about how to create peace in the next year. I'll tell you the formula pray + plan = peace. Come find out how this will give you what you really want. Click here to join us for Year of Calm.

episodes.title: Your Pre-Christmas Pep Talk
episodes.short: Your Pre-Christmas Pep Talk
episodes.description: We're in the homestretch. You're doing a great job. You've got this. Click here and enjoy the free 12 Days of Christmas I made for you.

episodes.title: Husband Sparkle for the Holidays
episodes.short: Husband Sparkle for the Holidays
episodes.description: Moms have it rough in December. And as we're drowning, we often forget to think about husbands. What does that guy need this year? Let's bring husbands a little sparkle too! episodes.title: Year of Calm Planner Available
episodes.short: Year of Calm Planner Available
episodes.description: Sign up for the Year of Calm workshop and order your physical planner so you have it before January 1st!

episodes.title: Remember to Breathe Rerun
episodes.short: Remember to Breathe Rerun
episodes.description: Alright, ladies. We're in the homestretch leading up to Christmas. This is my love letter to you to help you feel seen and appreciated. You've got this! And when you're ready for it... check out Year of Calm .

episodes.title: A No Disappointment Christmas Rerun
episodes.short: A No Disappointment Christmas Rerun
episodes.description: How many of you have planned on feeling disappointed this Christmas? Probably very few of you. And yet... so many of us feel disappointed at some time every year. I break down four common moments of disappointment and what we can do about them!

episodes.title: Handling Greif with Coach Nichole Haugen
episodes.short: Handling Greif with Coach Nichole Haugen
episodes.description: Today, I'm joined by grief coach Nichole Haugen. We're talking about how moms can take care of themselves when grief comes whether we see it coming or it's unexpected. To check out Nichole's website, visit www.nursegriefcoaching.com

episodes.title: How to Not Lose Your Mind Over Thanksgiving Break
episodes.short: How to Not Lose Your Mind Over Thanksgiving Break
episodes.description: Thanksgiving break is coming. Take a little time to do some planning so you don't lose your mind. It really is possible to enjoy Thanksgiving break with your big and little kids! Check out my new Advent book on Amazon here.

episodes.title: Receive the Good and the Hard
episodes.short: Receive the Good and the Hard
episodes.description: I had the most wonderful Saturday morning and I want to tell you about it. It gave me such a profound understanding of the good and the hard of motherhood. Grab my new Advent book on Amazon by clicking this link.

episodes.title: Death and Purgatory
episodes.short: Death and Purgatory
episodes.description: I know we don't want to think about or talk about death but we must. It's a real part of living. We must live well to die well. Whatever you're worried about today isn't as important as your salvation. Let's talk about how we can think about death in a positive way.

episodes.title: Less Stress for the Holidays
episodes.short: Less Stress for the Holidays
episodes.description: You absolutely do not have to be stressed in November and December. Fight the culture, say no to stress and yes to peace. I give many examples of how to do this. Click this link and come join me for my Less Stress for the Holidays program! Be Merry: How to Advent With Losing Your Mind book on Amazon. Past Holiday Episodes: A No Disappointment Christmas Black Friday Strategy Home for Break Protocol Deciding Ahead of Time (How you want to feel on Christmas) Life is Too Short for Toxic Relationships No One Puts Anything on Your Calendar Intentional Advent

episodes.title: Pumpkin Spice Lattes and Liturgical Living
episodes.short: Pumpkin Spice Lattes and Liturgical Living
episodes.description: Being smothered by pumpkin spice-flavored everything? Every time PSL takes over, it makes me think of the C.S. Lewis quote I share on this episode. Our heart are made for Liturgical Living. But I warn you not to do too much and lose your mind! If you haven't read my book Catholic Mom Calm, click here and check out the reviews on Amazon.

episodes.title: What Real Progress Looks Like
episodes.short: What Real Progress Looks Like
episodes.description: When we want to make big changes in our lives, we often look for huge leaps. Real progress is often done in baby steps and often with two steps forward and one step back. But it's still worth it! If you're interested in joining my Catholic Marriage Hope program, click this link to read more about it . Click here to watch my free hour-long class for women in painful Catholic marriages.

episodes.title: Taylor Swift and Halloween Rerun
episodes.short: Taylor Swift and Halloween Rerun
episodes.description: Be gentle with me. I have some thoughts about Taylor Swift and Halloween and I want to share them so you see how I make decisions about what I'm willing to listen to or do with my kids.

episodes.title: Teens Dating
episodes.short: Teens Dating
episodes.description: When teens are interested in dating, we often freak out. We don't want them to make mistakes. We don't want to screw up their ideas of love and marriage. We don't want to feel like we have no idea what we're doing. Let's talk about it!

episodes.title: When Plans Don't Go According to Plan
episodes.short: When Plans Don't Go According to Plan
episodes.description: September is like a mini-January and so often when things don't go as we planned... we feel awful. We beat ourselves up and we feel like failures before the month is even up. Let's talk about it!

episodes.title: How to Serve Your Husband
episodes.short: How to Serve Your Husband
episodes.description: Serving husbands can be a hot topic these days but it's what we are called to do. Let me explain how I do it even when I'm feeling... resistant.

episodes.title: God is Good, All the Time
episodes.short: God is Good, All the Time
episodes.description: Let me teach you a simple tool that you can use with your friends when either of you is having a tough time. It's free and you can text it!

episodes.title: Yes, The Food Is Poisoned
episodes.short: Yes, The Food Is Poisoned
episodes.description: Yes, our food is mostly poisoned but don't lose hope. We can still have peace living in 2024. Don't let the food situation cause you stress and create disconnection with your kids. Tucker Carlson and Casey and Calley interview on YouTube.

episodes.title: Stories of 5 Peaceful Moms
episodes.short: Stories of 5 Peaceful Moms
episodes.description: Today I'm celebrating these five moms and the peace they've found in their lives. Yes, motherhood can be hard, but you don't have to be miserable. Come listen to how these ladies did it! Click here to join me for Mary's Heart & Martha's Order - an 8-week challenge for Catholic moms! We start September 3rd. Daily podcast where I explain the model. Start here and listen to the next three episodes. They're short! Katie Cudworth IG: @themenuandme Olivia McCarthy IG: @oliviamccarthyauthor Ruby Roth IG: @motheringevepodcast

episodes.title: A Mary Martha Motherhood
episodes.short: A Mary Martha Motherhood
episodes.description: How can we bring both Mary energy and Martha energy to motherhood? We want a balance of both but we're always feeling pulled in so many directions. Stay tuned for the sign-up to our upcoming Mary's Heart a\& Martha's Order 8-week challenge for Catholic moms!

episodes.title: Everyone Needs Me
episodes.short: Everyone Needs Me
episodes.description: When you have the thought, "Everyone needs me," how do you feel? And when you feel that way, how do you show up in your life? We're going to talk about what else we can think and how we really choose what we do. Stay tuned... an exciting announcement is coming up!

episodes.title: Getting on the Same Page as Your Husband
episodes.short: Getting on the Same Page as Your Husband
episodes.description: Of course, we want to be on the same page as our husbands. This is true in big things and in small things. But... how do we actually do it? Lt's talk about it.

episodes.title: Are all moms people pleasers?
episodes.short: Are all moms people pleasers?
episodes.description: People pleaser is a negative term. We never say it as a compliment. And yet, I think all women have some people-pleasing tendencies in them. So what does that mean? Let's reclaim having a heart of service.

episodes.title: Transitioning Seasons Well
episodes.short: Transitioning Seasons Well
episodes.description: We're talking about transitioning from summer to school as an example of how to transition well. Transitioning from one chapter of your life to the next is a skill. You can get better at it and today, I'll tell you how.

episodes.title: Having a Great Day
episodes.short: Having a Great Day
episodes.description: Would you like to have a great day to day? Let me help you! I'll tell you my tricks for turning things around and feeling great.

episodes.title: The Intolerance of Summer
episodes.short: The Intolerance of Summer
episodes.description: It's not you... it's stress. Your ability to tolerate individual stressors and all the stressors in your life. Let's talk about how you can handle stress better so you can have a peaceful summer!

episodes.title: Marriage Program Update!
episodes.short: Marriage Program Update!
episodes.description: Extending the deadline to Monday becuase we didn't mention the payment plans on the sales page. Listen to this Q&A call to get all your questions answered! Sign up for Catholic Marriage Hope here .

episodes.title: Timing Belts and Tidy Kitchens
episodes.short: Timing Belts and Tidy Kitchens
episodes.description: Do you know how to change the timing belt in your car? Probably not. But you probably do know what it is. This is similar to how husbands are about tidying the house. Let's get into it! For access to my FREE Catholic Marriage HOpe class, Click here.

episodes.title: Four Ways to Cope with Painful Crosses
episodes.short: Four Ways to Cope with Painful Crosses
episodes.description: I've had a painful marriage for a long time, and the skills I've learned to cope with it well have helped me get out of feelings of anger, hopelessness, and loneliness. I break down the four steps and you can apply them to your own marriage or another painful cross. If you're interested in joining my new Catholic Marriage Hope program, click here.

episodes.title: How to Coach Yourself
episodes.short: How to Coach Yourself
episodes.description: Today I break down five examples of coaching women through everyday mom problems and how you can coach yourself in a similar way!

episodes.title: Receiving the Gift of Today
episodes.short: Receiving the Gift of Today
episodes.description: No matter what start to summer you're having, let's talk about the power of receiving the gift of today. How do you normally receive gifts? With disappointment? Feeling underserving of the gifts? How would Mary receive a gift from the Lord?

episodes.title: Christ is the Answer
episodes.short: Christ is the Answer
episodes.description: I talk about a lot of practical things in this podcast but let us not forget, the answer to everything is Christ. He is the Alpha and the Omega and He is the solution for everything. Come join us for Keep Your Cool at www.catholicmomcalm.com/keepyourcool

episodes.title: Our Love/Hate Relationship with Summer
episodes.short: Our Love/Hate Relationship with Summer
episodes.description: Ah, summer. The season we love and the season that turns us into fire-breathing dragon moms. Not this year, my friends! Let's adjust our expectations so we can limit our anger this summer! Come join us for Keep Your Cool at www.catholicmomcalm.com/keepyourcool

episodes.title: Schooling Guilt and Stress
episodes.short: Schooling Guilt and Stress
episodes.description: School is wrapping up and we often have lots of thoughts about ourselves. We feel stress and guilt and it can leave negative impressions with whatever what we've chosen to educate our kids. Let's break it down! For more resources, visit www.catholicmomcalm.com

episodes.title: 5 Thoughts That Can Improve Your Marriage Rerun
episodes.short: 5 Thoughts That Can Improve Your Marriage Rerun
episodes.description: Do you have a painful marriage? Perhaps you love your marriage but there are still some things you find annoying. In this episode, Sterling shares five powerful thoughts you can use today to improve your marriage. Whether you've been in a difficult season for years or you're just having an off day, these thoughts can help you look at that man with fresh eyes and have some hope for the future!

episodes.title: Run to the Lord
episodes.short: Run to the Lord
episodes.description: No matter what you're dealing with, Jesus is the answer. This week we're talking about the promises of God and how He can bring you rest and peace... but we must remember to run to Him to receive this.

episodes.title: Not Enjoying Motherhood
episodes.short: Not Enjoying Motherhood
episodes.description: Have you ever had moments or seasons where you didn't enjoy motherhood? It feels like something we're not allowed to admit. But here's the good news - we can not enjoy something and still REALLY WANT to do something!

episodes.title: Stop Settling for Stress
episodes.short: Stop Settling for Stress
episodes.description: I super duper promise you... you don't have to be as stressed as you are. Today I'll explain why we're so stressed and how we can get our brains on board to chill out a little bit. Come join us in Catholic Mom Calm!

episodes.title: The Chaos of May is Coming
episodes.short: The Chaos of May is Coming
episodes.description: May is coming and so too are sacraments, graduations, Mother's Day, Memorial Day, and the winding down of school and Spring. How can we make plans this year to have more peace in a busy season? Join us in Catholic Mom Calm at www.sterlingjaquith.com

episodes.title: Time to Begin Again
episodes.short: Time to Begin Again
episodes.description: With Spring comes a renewed dedication to things like exercise, homeschooling, prayer, and working on our relationships. How do we begin again when our past threatens to hold us back? With the Lord, of course.

episodes.title: Divine Mercy is our Light in the Darkness
episodes.short: Divine Mercy is our Light in the Darkness
episodes.description: I had a hard week, which was a little jarring considering it was the week after Easter, and we should be in a celebratory mood. But here's how I deal with hard weeks and how the words we hear from Jesus in Saint Faustina's diary can give us hope.

episodes.title: Hope, Healing, and Holy Week
episodes.short: Hope, Healing, and Holy Week
episodes.description: Let us lean into Holy Week to find hope and healing. The Lord is waiting to meet us with mercy and we see how great His mercy is in the retelling of His Passion. Don't forget to start the Divine Mercy novena on Good Friday!

episodes.title: Cabrini and Divine Mercy
episodes.short: Cabrini and Divine Mercy
episodes.description: My thoughts about the new Cabrini movie and what I think we should all rememeber about Divine Mercy.

episodes.title: You're Allowed to Have a Bad Day
episodes.short: You're Allowed to Have a Bad Day
episodes.description: We know that we have bad days and yet... we're always surprised when they come. When we think we're supposed to handle every day well, our brains start to fritz out. Here's what we can do about it.

episodes.title: The Kids Talk Too Much!
episodes.short: The Kids Talk Too Much!
episodes.description: Drowning in noise? Do your kids as too many questions? Let's talk about why we're all feeling so fried!

episodes.title: Ordinary Wins
episodes.short: Ordinary Wins
episodes.description: Do you know what feels amazing? Winning. And yet there are no mom awards. Today we're celebrating a bunch or ordinary mom moments so you too can see what an amazing job you're doing!
